question: Who among the following personalities is an exponent of Kathak dance in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prerna Shrimali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Senior** Kathak dancer** of the **Jaipur Gharana is Prerana Shrimali**.
 
• **Shrimati Prerana Shrimali,** who was born in **Banswara, Rajasthan**, was trained in **Kathak dancing by Guru Shri Kundan lal Gangani in Jaipur**. Subsequently, she received instruction in the art from the same **Guru, late Shri Kundan Lal Gangani **of the **Jaipur gharana**, at **Kathak Kendra in New Delhi.**
 
• She has also taken part in numerous international dance seminars and conferences and created a number of performances.
 
• Also, she has trained young dancers at **Shriram Bharatiya Kala Kendra and Gandharva Mahavidyalaya.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak dance**

 
 
• ​One of the eight primary styles of Indian classical dance is **kathak**.
 
• It is an **Uttar Pradesh** classical dancing style. The storytellers or itinerant bards known as **Kathakars** in **ancient northern India** are often credited as the creators of **Kathak**.
 
• The **Vedic Sanskrit words Katha**, which means "story," and **Kathakar**, which means "the one who tells a story" or "to do with stories," are the roots of the word **Kathak**.
 
• Traveling **Kathakars** used dance, songs, and music to transmit tales from the great epics and ancient mythology. **Kathak dancers** use intricate footwork, flexible body movements, and, most importantly, expressive face expressions to convey a variety of stories.
